title: users.profile_updated
description: ProfileUpdated is published by identify when a user is created and every time their public profile or status changes. It is a full snapshot, not a diff, so consumers don't need the previous state. Version is identify's profile_version: it grows with every change of the same user, and a consumer applies a snapshot only if its version is higher than the one it already has (duplicates and out-of-order deliveries are then harmless). Only public fields travel: the email never does.

event_id.description: Identificador único del evento. Usar para deduplicar (at-least-once).

occurred_at.description: Momento del hecho de negocio, ISO 8601 en UTC.

version.description: profile_version del usuario en identify. Crece con cada cambio; ordena las fotos del mismo usuario.

avatar_url.description: URL pública del avatar, o vacío si no tiene.

status_text.description: Texto del estado personalizado, o vacío si no tiene.

status_emoji.description: Emoji del estado personalizado, o vacío si no tiene.
